description: A spawn point marker system that defines player spawn locations in the game world. Marks objects as spawn points with visual editor representation showing position and forward direction. documentation:
## Spawn Point

A spawn point marker system that defines player spawn locations in the game world. It marks objects for runtime spawn lookup and adds an editor-only marker showing position and facing direction.

### Key Features
- Visual spawn point marker in editor
- Configurable spawn slot numbers
- Normal and team spawn metadata
- Forward direction indicator
- Transparent selection box for editor picking
- Structured userData.spawnPoint metadata
- Empty runtime update loop

### How It Works
1. Attach to an empty object or mesh in the scene.
2. Configure the spawn number and spawn type.
3. Position and rotate the object where the player should appear.
4. The behavior sets target.userData.isSpawnPoint = true and target.userData.spawnPoint = {slot, type}.
5. In editor mode it creates a SpawnPointMarker in sceneHelpers.
6. The marker syncs only when the target transform changes.
7. Runtime spawn systems can query userData.isSpawnPoint or userData.spawnPoint.

### Technical Details
- Marker: SpawnPointMarker extends THREE.Group
- Selection box: transparent BoxGeometry attached to the target
- Position sync: marker.position.copy(target.position) after changes
- Rotation sync: marker.quaternion.copy(target.quaternion) after changes
- Spawn slot attribute: number type, min 0
- Spawn type attribute: enum ["normal", "team"]
- Cleanup removes helper objects and clears spawn metadata when the behavior is removed
